_about: Shapes of every v1 server endpoint that fed filter option lists, plus the query parameters the exchange-rates page actually sent. The 'before' picture for harvest §8. All response examples are illustrative values in the documented shape.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT fromCurrencyCode FROM exchange_rates ORDER BY fromCurrencyCode
SELECT DISTINCT toCurrencyCode FROM exchange_rates ORDER BY toCurrencyCode
SELECT DISTINCT source FROM exchange_rates ORDER BY source

exchangeRatesAvailableDates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT date FROM exchange_rates ORDER BY date DESC

whatThePageSent.date: min..max of all selected existing days → startDate/endDate (flattened)
whatThePageSent.fromCurrencyCode: sent only when exactly 1 value selected; ≥2 values filtered client-side on the 200-row page

documentsInboxFilterOptions.scope: tenant, linkedEntityId IS NULL, status != DELETED

clientSideOptionLists.where: partners/page.tsx, supplier-invoices, expenses, company-purchases, payroll, time-entries, banking/transactions
clientSideOptionLists.how: new Set(rows.map(r => r.col)) over the rows already loaded; '__NULL__' prepended when a blank exists; date columns pass the rows' dates as dateValues
clientSideOptionLists.consequence: options reflect the loaded page only; no counts; no narrowing

notAFilterEndpoint.purpose: ECB currency catalogue for the admin 'add currency' screen

v3Target.distinct: queries.distinct(tx, col, filters) → { values: [{ value, label?, count }], truncated }
v3Target.distinctDates: queries.distinctDates(tx, col, filters) → [{ year, count, months: [{ month, count, days: [{ day, count }] }] }]

properties.narrowedByActiveFilters: all filters except the column's own
